learning_outcomes.text: Define a clear and precise methodology to carry out the development of any mechatronic system.
Select the most suitable motors for each application, as well as their drivers.
Use microcontrollers in mechatronic and embedded systems.
Develop a complete mechatronic prototype: from its design to its final implementation.

syllabus_topics: Power Supply and Actuation of Mechatronic Prototypes

assessment_methods.method: Power Supply and Actuation of Mechatronic Prototypes (ALIM)

assessment_rules: To pass the course "Mechatronic Design II", students must pass the three local Master's subjects. The final grade is calculated as 0.6 * ALIM + 0.2 * SSM + 0.2 * PROY. It is mandatory to pass all three local courses; if not met, the final grade will be FAIL, and the numerical grade will be the weighted average or 4.0, whichever is lower. If a student does not attend all local subject exams, their final grade will be NOT PRESENTED (NP) or FAIL depending on attendance, with participation in at least 50% of activities obliging a grade.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica (EPI Gijón)
degree: Máster Erasmus Mundus en Ingeniería Mecatrónica
